newsitem.title: GERMANY: Iberia to start direct Uruguay flights.
newsitem.headline: Iberia to start direct Uruguay flights.

text.p: Spanish national airline Iberia will start twice-weekly direct flights to Uruguay on July 4, German cargo officials said.

The airline will fly Wednesdays and Fridays from Madrid to Montevideo via Sao Paulo with an Airbus A340 with up to 15 tonnes airfreight capacity, Iberia German cargo sales manager George von Doehren said.
Iberia currently has daily flights to Uruguay but with a change of aircraft at its Buenos Aires hub, he added.
"We and KLM will be the only European airlines flying to Montevideo and we expect good freight demand for the destination," von Doehren said.
Despite its closeness to Argentina, Uruguay was a distinct cargo market which could be served separately, he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+5017
